LAW AND MOTION 301, THE COURT ADOPTED IT'S TENTATIVE RULING AS FOLLOWS - DEFENDANTS CITY AND COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO AND PHILIP WELSH'S MOTION FOR SUMMARY ADJUDICATION IS DENIED, TO THE EXTENT THE MOTION FOR SUMMARY JUDGMENT CHALLENGES THE SUFFICIENCY OF THE PLEADINGS, IT IS TREATED AS A MOTION FOR JUDGMENT ON THE PLEADINGS AND IS AN INAPPROPRIATE MOTION TO RECONSIDER. IT IS DENIED ON THAT BASIS AND FOR THE SAME REASONS THE ORIGINAL MOTION WAS DENIED TO THE EXTENT IT ADDRESSES THE FACTUAL BASIS FOR THE INTENTIONAL INFLICTION OF EMOTIONAL DISTRESS CLAIM, IT IS DENIED BECAUSE THERE ARE TRIABLE ISSUES OF MATERIAL FACT AS TO THE DEFENDANT'S CONDUCT AND WHETHER THAT CONDUCT CONSTITUTES INTENTIONAL INFLICTION OF EMOTIONAL DISTRESS.
